data.one_liner: A Flutter code editor widget with syntax highlighting, custom themes, and file navigation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a multi-file code editor widget for Flutter with syntax highlighting via flutter_highlight, custom themes, undo/redo options, and text formatters.
use_when: You want to allow users to view and edit source code (dart, js, html, css, etc.) within a mobile or desktop app.
You need a ready-made code editor component with built-in syntax highlighting and file navigation tabs.
avoid_when: You are building a dedicated desktop/web-only IDE where advanced platform-specific code editing features are critical.
You require complex code completion (IntelliSense), find-and-replace, or deep text-mate grammar integrations.
strengths: Supports multiple files with a built-in navigation bar and individual readonly configurations.
Customizable styling including font sizes, custom themes, undo/redo buttons, and button positioning.
weaknesses: Primarily designed to make it easier to write code on mobile, lacking advanced features expected on desktop/web IDEs.
Requires wrapping in a SingleChildScrollView to avoid layout overflows from phone keypads.
data.setup_notes: No native setup required. Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
